land_owner.note: DERIVED, and re-derived by tools/resolve_land_tracts.py --check: this block is not hand-authored and a hand-edit fails the gate. This structure's committed position falls inside T39N R14E sec 09 E2NE on the PLSS grid this project constructs from its ONE control point — G1, State & Madison, the corner of sections 9/10/15/16 — carried on the plat's own east-west bearing at the nominal section mile. The grid is a construction and not a survey (L219), G1 carries a 13.9 m residual and the position itself carries the record's own uncertainty, so a structure near a section line may be on the other side of it. AND A PURCHASE IS NOT A TITLE: Alexander Wolcott entered this tract from the United States on 1830-09-29, which is what the register records and all it records. It does not say who held the ground on 1 July 1835, in a town whose whole business that year was selling it again.
